caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate glass container with a lid, rendered in various shades of blue. The container has a wide bowl that narrows at the base, which sits on a sturdy, octagonal pedestal and round foot. The sides of the bowl are vertically paneled and flare outward near the top, with scalloped edges forming an undulating rim. The domed lid mirrors the paneling of the bowl and is topped with a faceted, rounded finial. The entire object is colored in deep blue, with lighter and darker areas indicating reflections and shadows, suggesting a glassy, translucent material. The drawing is placed on a plain background, and the object occupies the center of the composition. The artist's name, "JANET RIZA," is written in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Sugar Bowl
